capabilities: Publish opted-in notes as a static site to AWS S3 and CloudFront
Deploy and configure AWS publishing infrastructure from settings
Opt notes into sites via publish contexts and stable per-note UIDs
Open published links as stacked panes so readers view notes side by side
Gate published content with sign-in and commenting
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a publishing tool, not a note-taking or knowledge-organization method.
extras: Desktop-only; version 0.2.0 is in beta and installed via BRAT rather than the community plugin store. Requires deploying AWS infrastructure, which the user must have or create.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to self-host published notes on your own AWS infrastructure with a stacked-panes reading experience.

relations.evidence: Sites are self-hosted on AWS (S3 + CloudFront)

summary: Publishes a curated subset of your vault as a self-hosted static site on AWS S3 and CloudFront, with links that open notes in stacked side panes.
